description:
Goal: A pure binary type operation or comparison over the same immutable operand handles must be evaluated once per Types world, then reuse its answer without rewalking, cloning, normalizing, or descriptor hashing.

Authority: one Types-owned operation-result table keyed only by operation tag plus Ty u32 operands. It stores only the canonical Ty returned by Types::intern; it introduces no raw descriptor equality, normalization, or semantic authority. Reuse the existing comparison memo for pure predicates, extending it only for a missing pure binary query if needed.

Scope: audit union, intersect, difference, refine_widen, and value-disjointness. Preserve current operand orientation where identity is observably directional; prove and normalize a symmetric key only where exact Ty result is established in the current supported domain. Stateful substitution/constraint collection is outside this ticket.

TDD: prove first evaluation records one miss and exact repetition one hit with no extra boundary work; prove a different operation and an ordered inverse cannot collide; prove any symmetric operation reuses reversed operands only after an exact-identity law. Run canonical/fixture gates and record per-operation hit/miss counts on enum_take_drop_split.

Acceptance: document key authority and scope, strict focused/corpus/three-door gates, format/check/Clippy, cold review, one commit and close.
title: Memoize pure binary Ty algebra by operand identity
